name: What types of window frame materials are available for replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of window frame materials are available for replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common window frame materials include vinyl, wood, fiberglass, and aluminum. Vinyl frames are a popular, cost-effective choice known for their energy efficiency and low maintenance. Wood frames offer a classic aesthetic and good insulation but require more maintenance. Fiberglass frames are durable, energy-efficient, and resistant to warping and rot. Aluminum frames are strong and slender, often used in contemporary designs, but can be less energy-efficient unless they have thermal breaks. Each material has different characteristics regarding durability, aesthetics, and insulation.
